text.tspan: Blocks 5-8 regenerate the keystream of blocks 1-4 — every pair is a two-time pad within one stream.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: The invariant: an identical counter block under an identical key always yields an identical keystream block.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Real systems meet this by field sizing, not by AES wrapping: RFC 3686 §4 gives the block counter 32 bits,

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: capping one packet at 2³² − 1 blocks (68,719,476,720 octets) before the counter would repeat under that key.

text.tspan: Scope: educational illustration of counter reuse; the demo wraps a tiny counter in software rather than overflowing AES.
